decision_summary: AI Org Labs migration is approved as clean-history publication, not history-preserving transfer.
rationale: Clean-history publication best satisfies the privacy requirement because existing Git author metadata carries legacy identity. Tracked-file scan is clean after source URL replacement, and legacy tags must not be pushed.
recommendation: Proceed with tests, identifier scan, clean initial commit, new remote setup, and push only sanitized main.
expected_user_reaction: Use the new repository as the public QIF development home without legacy personal identity exposure.
artifact_change_recommendations: Do not add QIF features; only sanitize source references and add migration evidence.
organization_change_recommendations: Treat AI Org Labs as the publication owner for QIF and AOF references.
